content:
hannah: Packaging window for private/vpc at 04:20 UTC. Goal: ship signed installer + change window announcement. Need cosign handoff and mirror pubkey propagation.

omar: I'm running dedupe + deterministic manifest writer now. ETA 6m.

lee: Ops note: mirrors often cache cosign.pub; we'll invalidate caches pre-seed. Also set a bandwidth cap per lane to avoid congestion.

ops-zoe: Watchlist set. Abort criteria: >2 verify failures in any lane in 5m or avg pull latency >100s for 3m. I'll throttle if needed.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] created pin private-installer@v2026.03.21 -> sha256:fa12bc34, upload s3://redwood-offline/releases/2833331000/ pending cosign.

omar: Cosign signed with installer-signer-09. Uploaded cosign.pub to s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign-2026-03.pub and triggered mirror invalidation hook.

hannah: Canary plan: 3 lanes, 2 seeds each, 90s spacing, 20m observe. If canary passes -> rolling batches of 4 every 12m.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary started: lanes=[north,east,south], seeds=6, start_ts=2833331000.

lee: Canary update (8m): north OK, east partial (1 verify fail), south OK. Cause: one mirror had stale cosign cache. Invalidating now.

ops-zoe: Cache flush applied. If node fails verify after 2 retries we evict and re-seed.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary status: 20m observation complete. All seeds verified post-invalidation. Canary PASSED.

hannah: Proceeding to rolling batches in +10m. Ops - publish release notes and KMS audit id when ready.

ops-zoe: KMS audit logged KMS-2026-03-21-01. Release notes sent to private-customers. TTL set to 90d.

omar: Post-mortem todo: add explicit cosign.pub propagation step to packaging CI and a mirror-agent hook unit test. Filing ticket PKG-2026-18.

hannah: Thanks team. Closing thread unless a late blocker shows.
